ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student mental health support and resource navigator.
ideas.title: CampusCare AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven multi-agent RAG patterns similar to past winning educational platforms, hitting high-priority student welfare concerns directly.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered hyper-local nutrition and meal planning platform for college students using local food pantries and dining halls.
ideas.title: NutriLocal Rochester
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts a proven 24-hour hackathon-winning architecture while solving an immediate, concrete local student problem in Rochester.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven patient acquisition and trust engine tailored for local student health clinics and wellness centers.
ideas.title: ClinicTrust Rochester
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly ports a proven short-sprint winning concept into a practical local utility that judges can easily test and evaluate.

ideas.pitch: Satellite and campus telemetry monitoring dashboard for tracking institutional energy waste and sustainability metrics.
ideas.title: EcoCampus AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mimics the technical presentation style of successful geospatial monitoring hacks, which consistently impress judges with visual dashboards.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous peer-to-peer student service marketplace utilizing secure escrow payments.
ideas.title: CampusEscrow Market
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies a proven marketplace and escrow pattern from recent winning hackathon projects to a familiar university ecosystem.
